name: Cut Short
oracle_text:
Convoke (Your creatures can help cast this spell. Each creature you tap while casting this spell pays for {1} or one mana of that creature's color.)
Destroy target planeswalker that was activated this turn or tapped creature.
blocked_sentences: Destroy target planeswalker that was activated this turn or tapped creature.

needs.what: a selector key matching a permanent one of whose abilities (here, a planeswalker's loyalty ability) was activated this turn, read from the per-turn activation ledger (turn_ledger.activated / the per-object record of activations), so a target can be 'planeswalker that was activated this turn'; combined via any_of with {types: [Creature], tapped: true}
needs.why_existing_wont_do: selector_keys has entered_this_turn, attacked_this_turn, drawn_this_turn, surveilled_this_turn and tapped, but nothing about activations; the turn ledger records activations per object and loyalty_activations per player, yet no selector exposes it. Dropping the clause (any planeswalker) or the planeswalker half would change which targets are legal. Convoke itself is expressible as pay_generic_with: tap_creatures
